test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a key objective of Micro Finance Institutions in India?

options.text: Providing loans exclusively to women entrepreneurs
Promoting financial inclusion and poverty alleviation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Promoting financial inclusion and poverty alleviation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Objectives of Micro Finance Institution:

 
• They give customers small loans with no collateral requirements and simple credit, thus help in** promoting financial inclusion and poverty alleviation**
 
• It increases the amount of money available to the poorer sectors of the economy, increasing their income and employment.
 
• Its goal includes serving individuals with limited financial resources, such as women, the unemployed, and persons with impairments.
 
• By educating people about the financial resources accessible to them and encouraging a culture of saving, it benefits the underprivileged and marginalized members of society.
 
• Families who get microloans are more likely to give their kids a better and ongoing education.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MFI **is a company that provides low-income people with financial services.
 
• Microloans, micro-savings, and microinsurance are some of these services.
 
• MFIs are financial institutions that offer modest loans to borrowers without access to banking services.
 
• The term "small loans" has different meanings in different nations.
 
• All loans in India that are less than Rs. 1 lakh can be categorized as microloans.
